description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

The Opportunity 

We are seeking an Agency Partnerships Director to build and scale 6sense's agency and systems integrator Partner program. You will own the strategy and operating model for these Partners, working with agencies, consultancies, and SIs to create a repeatable source of pipeline, quality implementations, and customer retention. 

You report to the Head of Partnerships & Alliances, and independently set the direction for agency and SI Partnerships, then lead its execution across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and Marketing. You set the standards and playbooks that others follow. 

Go-to-market is being rebuilt around agents, and the Partners who design and run that work are choosing their platforms now. Your job is to help make 6sense the GTM intelligence layer they build on. 

What You Will Do 

  • Program strategy and ownership: Define and own the agency and SI Partner strategy, including segmentation, targets, and investment priorities. Bring the Head of Partnerships & Alliances clear recommendations on where to focus and what to stop. 
  • Strategic Partner relationships: Build executive-level relationships with leaders at priority agencies, consultancies, and SIs, and lead joint business plans and quarterly reviews. 
  • Program design and scale: Design the Partner lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, tiering, incentives, and program requirements, with playbooks that scale beyond your own direct involvement. 
  • Certification and delivery quality: Define the certification model and quality standards for Partner-delivered work, and work with Enablement and Professional Services to deliver it at scale. 
  • Partner-led delivery model: Partner with Professional Services leadership to define how Partner-led implementations extend capacity rather than compete with it, including coverage and handoff models. 
  • Joint solutions and go-to-market: Shape packaged Partner offerings, including implementation, managed services, and agentic GTM on 6sense, and align Sales and Marketing on how to bring them into deals. 
  • Co-sell operating model: Establish account mapping, deal registration, and rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Success leadership, and report on Partner-sourced and Partner-influenced pipeline to senior leadership. 
  • Product and market influence: Turn Partner insight into roadmap input, especially what agencies and SIs need to run 6sense across multiple clients, and represent 6sense's Partner program in the agency and SI community. 
  • Mentorship and standards: Coach peers and less experienced team members on Partner practices, and set the standards for how Partner work is done. 

Key Outcomes 

  • A scalable program: A documented agency and SI program with clear tiers, playbooks, and operating rhythms, adopted by Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services. 
  • Partner-driven revenue: Measurable growth in Partner-sourced and Partner-influenced pipeline and closed-won against a program-level target. 
  • Certified delivery capacity: A growing bench of certified Partner practitioners delivering quality implementations at scale. 
  • Sellable joint offerings: Packaged Partner solutions that Sales uses in active deals across segments. 
  • Retention impact: Partner-led customers renewing and expanding. 
  • Market position: 6sense established as a preferred GTM intelligence platform among priority agencies and SIs. 

What You Bring 

Must-haves 

  • 12+ years in SaaS, agency, or consulting environments, including 8+ years in Partnerships, alliances, or channel roles. 
  • Proven record of independently setting Partner strategy and building programs, from planning through pipeline and revenue results. 
  • Executive-level relationships with agency, consultancy, or SI leaders, and experience working with Partners of different sizes, from large agencies and SIs to boutique firms. 
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding a program-level Partner-sourced or Partner-influenced pipeline or revenue target. 
  • Experience designing and running co-sell models with a direct sales team, and influencing Sales, Customer Success, and Services leaders without direct authority. 
  • Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, including the ability to weigh intangibles, make tradeoffs, and recommend a path to senior leaders. 

Nice-to-haves 

  • Martech, adtech, or revenue technology background. 
  • Experience designing Partner certification or enablement programs. 
  • Working knowledge of ABM, intent data, or agentic AI in GTM. 
  • Time on the agency or consultancy side. 
  • An existing network across agencies, GTM consultancies, or SIs. 
  • Experience mentoring or leading other Partner team members. 

Working Profile 

  • Self-starter: Brings structure and follow-through to a program that is still taking shape. 
  • Commercial mindset: Ties every Partnership to pipeline and customer outcomes. 
  • Trusted executive contact: Earns credibility with agency and SI leaders as a peer. 

Base Salary Range: $146,206.50 - $214,436.20. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy

Our Benefits: 

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. 

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com. 

We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com
